title: Garrison / HTTP API
description: REST traffic by route template, method, status, and tenant: rates, latency percentiles, sizes, errors, and in-flight requests.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Garrison node: the server pod or container name, or the worker node name.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.description: Tenant ID. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Runs are infrequent, so short windows leave gaps.

list.name: search
list.label: Log text
list.description: Filters log panels to lines that contain this text.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: REST requests in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_http_requests_total{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: Average REST request rate over the averaging window.

targets.expr: sum(rate(garrison_http_requests_total{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$window])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Server errors (5xx)
panels.description: Requests answered with a 5xx status in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_http_requests_total{status_class="5xx", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered 5xx over the averaging window.

targets.expr: sum(rate(garrison_http_requests_total{status_class="5xx", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$window])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(garrison_http_requests_total{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$window])), 1e-9) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: REST requests being handled right now, including long polls and streams.

targets.expr: sum(garrison_http_requests_in_flight{node=~"$node"}) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile REST request duration over the averaging window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Requests by status class (per second)
panels.description: Request rate by status class.

targets.expr: sum by (status_class) (rate(garrison_http_requests_total{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "status_class", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Requests by route (top 15, per second)
panels.description: The busiest route templates. Routes are templates, never raw paths, so cardinality stays bounded.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (method, route) (rate(garrison_http_requests_total{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "method", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Requests by tenant (per second)
panels.description: Request rate by the tenant in the path, or the caller's tenant.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant) (rate(garrison_http_requests_total{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "tenant", "none", "", "")

panels.title: In-flight requests
panels.description: Requests being handled, per replica.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (garrison_http_requests_in_flight{node=~"$node"}) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "node", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Request latency
panels.description: REST request duration percentiles across the selected routes. Exemplar dots open the trace.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: p95 latency by route (top 15)
panels.description: Slowest route templates by 95th percentile.

targets.expr: topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(garrison_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$window])))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "route", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Watson server latency p95 by route
panels.description: Watson's built-in http.server.request.duration, the HTTP foundation metric, by route.

targets.expr: topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node", otel_scope_name="Watson"}[$window])))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "http_route", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Watson connections and exceptions
panels.description: Open connections, and listener exceptions per minute, from Watson's own metrics.

targets.expr: sum(watson_server_connections_active{node=~"$node"}) or on() vector(0)
sum(rate(watson_server_exceptions_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Client errors by route (4xx, per minute)
panels.description: 4xx responses per minute by route and status code.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (route, status_code) (rate(garrison_http_requests_total{status_class="4xx", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "route", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Server errors by route (5xx, per minute)
panels.description: 5xx responses per minute by route and status code.

targets.expr: sum by (route, status_code) (rate(garrison_http_requests_total{status_class="5xx", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "route", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Request body size p95 by route
panels.description: 95th percentile request body size by route.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(garrison_http_request_size_bytes_bucket{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", node=~"$node"}[$window])))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "route", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Response body size p95 by route
panels.description: 95th percentile response body size by route; streamed responses report 0.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(garrison_http_response_size_bytes_bucket{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", node=~"$node"}[$window])))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "route", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Every route template that received traffic in the selected range: requests, error share, and latency.

targets.expr: sum by (method, route) (increase(garrison_http_requests_total{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))

sum by (method, route) (increase(garrison_http_requests_total{status_class="5xx", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (method, route) (increase(garrison_http_requests_total{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__range])), 1)
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(garrison_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(garrison_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Request log lines
panels.description: Server request lines (debug severity) and route failures. Raise Logging.MinimumSeverity to 0 to see every request.

targets.expr: {app="garrison", component="server", node=~"${node:regex}"} |~ "\\[(GarrisonServer|Routes)\\]" |= "$search"
